headline: US Natural Gas Futures Fall Over 7% to $3.15 Per MMBtu on Profit-Taking
summary: US natural gas prices fell more than 7% to around $3.15 per million British thermal units on Monday as investors took profits following a rally to nine-month highs.
why: Natural gas Henry Hub futures benchmark energy heating costs and power producer fuel prices across North America.

impacts.name: US Natural Gas
impacts.why: US natural gas prices sank over 7% due to profit-taking following last week's rally.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Prices dropped as traders locked in profits after futures reached a nine-month high on forecasts of colder weather.
